_about: DRAFT preset sections for the Phase 1 game blocks (ROADMAP #74), in the shape of app.DEFAULTS. Not read by any code yet.
Conventions copied from the existing sections: font_size 0 = the body size; sizes and gaps in points, indents in inches; colours as '#rrggbb' or '' (none).

Every colour has a print_ twin: the value a print build uses (Phase 3's screen/print split). Until Phase 3, builds use the print_ value, so a black-and-white interior is safe from the first release. Every print_ fill is a light grey or '' and every print_ rule is black or grey.
The defaults below are deliberately plain (a light box, black rules) so that any existing style gets a sensible look without editing; the game-book presets (Phase 3) carry the genre colours.
Large print: add 'readaloud', 'sidebar' and 'statblock' to the min_text_size loop at app.py ~2167 (for key in ('document_block', 'poem', ...)), or a large-print book sets them smaller than 16pt.

statblock._rule_choices: tapered | plain | none (the rule under the name and under the fields)
statblock._scores_choices: row (one table row of NAME over score) | grid (two rows of three) - grid is for narrow columns
statblock._note: 'tapered' is the genre's convention (a rule thick in the middle, thin at the ends), drawn as a vector; the shape is common to the genre, so it is not trade dress, but the colours and fonts here must not copy any publisher's.
